title: VPN connection drops or fails to connect
steps: Check status page for the VPN gateway
Ask user to reconnect and note the exact error
Escalate to Network team if more than 5 users are affected

title: User locked out or password reset failing
steps: Verify identity through the approved channel
Unlock the account in the identity provider
If MFA device lost, follow the MFA re-enrolment procedure

title: Web application returns 5xx errors
steps: Check service status and recent deployments
Roll back the last deployment if errors started right after it

title: Database slow queries or connection exhaustion
steps: Escalate to Data platform team before changing indexes

title: Suspicious login or phishing report
steps: Isolate the affected account or device

title: Laptop or peripheral hardware failure
steps: Offer a loaner device if the user is blocked
